agents.name: Claude Code
agents.bestFor: Developers who want an agent that works directly in their terminal and codebase

pricing.display: Included with Claude Pro, from $20 / mo

pros: Handles multi-file changes and long tasks
Runs in the terminal, IDE or browser
Works with your existing git workflow
cons: Heavy use needs a higher plan
Best suited to people comfortable with a terminal

agents.name: Cursor
agents.bestFor: Developers who want an AI-first code editor with an agent built in
pros: Familiar editor, based on VS Code
Choice of several leading models
Free plan to try it out
cons: Usage-based credits make costs harder to predict

agents.name: Devin
agents.bestFor: Teams that want to hand off well-defined tickets to an autonomous engineer
pros: Works asynchronously in its own environment
Integrates with Slack and issue trackers
Opens pull requests for review
cons: Needs clearly scoped tasks to do well
Plans and limits have changed often

agents.name: Codex
agents.bestFor: ChatGPT users who want a coding agent without another subscription

pricing.display: Included with ChatGPT Plus, from $20 / mo

pros: Runs tasks in parallel in the cloud
Available in ChatGPT, the CLI and IDEs
No extra subscription for ChatGPT users
cons: Usage limits depend on your ChatGPT plan
Cloud tasks need a connected GitHub repo

agents.name: Fin
agents.bestFor: Support teams that want to resolve common questions automatically
pros: Pay per resolved conversation
Learns from your help centre content
Hands over to human agents
cons: Helpdesk seats are billed on top

agents.name: Perplexity
agents.bestFor: Quick, sourced answers and deeper research on any topic
pros: Cites its sources
Fast for everyday questions
Useful free plan
cons: Always check the sources it cites

agents.name: ChatGPT deep research
agents.bestFor: Long, multi-step research reports with citations

pricing.display: Included with ChatGPT Plus, from $20 / mo

pros: Writes structured reports from many sources
Works through a question step by step
Part of a tool many people already use

agents.name: Lindy
agents.bestFor: Small teams automating email, scheduling and admin work
pros: Set up agents in plain language
Connects to common business apps
Good for inbox and calendar tasks
